Resolves #19141

neo moves both `neo-agent-skills` pins from 0.1.15 to 0.1.16, published today with neomjs/neo-agent-skills#107, #108 and #110. `package.json` and the lock now install 0.1.16, and `pr-baseline.yml` calls the reusable workflow at `793b580` (skills `dev` after the #110 merge), whose own six version pins read 0.1.16. After merge, this repository's PR baseline requires exactly one standalone `Resolves` on every PR, and a seat's pre-push no longer refuses a rebased branch for operator-authored commits already on `dev`.

Evidence: L1 (pin change) → L1 required; this PR's own baseline run is the receipt for the install ACs. No residuals.

## AC Evidence
| AC-1 | `package.json` `"neo-agent-skills": "0.1.16"`; `package-lock.json` resolves the 0.1.16 tarball (`npm ci --dry-run` consistent) |
| AC-2 | `pr-baseline.yml` → `reusable-pr-baseline.yml@793b580587de226724e28dda7e11391c3e015fda` |
| AC-3 | this PR's baseline run installs 0.1.16; its PR-body job runs the close-target check this body passes |
| AC-4 | the baseline's "Skills materialized" job on this head |

## Deltas from ticket
None substantive. `npm install --save-exact` reformats `package.json`'s aligned columns, so the version line was edited by hand and only the lock kept npm's output: the same three-file shape as #19119.

## Test Evidence
All coverage runs in CI.

## Post-Merge Validation
- Nothing owed at merge. Each seat picks the local guards up on its next `npm install`.
